# Price Lists

Manage price lists in Teamleader Focus.

```php
Teamleader::priceLists()
```

| | |
|---|---|
| Class | `McoreServices\TeamleaderSDK\Resources\Products\PriceLists` |
| Create / update / delete | — / — / — |
| Pagination | No |

## Endpoints

- `priceLists.list`

## Filters

Passed as the first argument to `list()`. Any other key throws.

| Filter | Description |
|---|---|
| `ids` | Array of price list UUIDs to filter by |

## Methods

### `list()`

```php
list(array $filters = [], array $options = []): array
```

List price lists with filtering

- `$filters` — Filters to apply
- `$options` — Additional options (not used for this endpoint)

### `byIds()`

```php
byIds(array $ids): array
```

Get specific price lists by their UUIDs

- `$ids` — Array of price list UUIDs

## Examples

Get all price lists:

```php
$priceLists = Teamleader::priceLists()->list();
```

Get specific price lists by IDs:

```php
$priceLists = Teamleader::priceLists()->list(['ids' => ['uuid1', 'uuid2']]);
```

Get specific price lists (alias method):

```php
$priceLists = Teamleader::priceLists()->byIds(['uuid1', 'uuid2']);
```
